title: Repair CORRECTION11 defects: ReportLayout sole production writer, cli.py delegation, fail-closed range API, hermetic range fixture, detached evidence bound to production (CORRECTION12)

scope.prior_checkpoint: ACT-K9B-VERIFIER-CORE-MIGRATION-AUDIT01-CORRECTION11 (PARTIAL_CHECKPOINT; F11=75a43f3f, S11=0c9226e0; both under rescue refs rescue/audit01-correction11-{f11,s11})

known_defects_in_cor11.cli_has_duplicate_writer_logic: scripts/verifiers_audit/cli.py (cmd_write) re-implements shard encoding, hashing, atomic write, top-level index write, and markdown write. The single production writer is ReportLayout + write_all + write_audit; cli.py must only delegate.
known_defects_in_cor11.range_api_returns_empty_on_git_failure: scope.py _run_git_diff_names uses text=True and splitlines(); a non-zero exit code returns an empty tuple (Git failure is silently indistinguishable from a valid empty range). ReportLayout logic and tests must never confuse failure with empty.
known_defects_in_cor11.range_functions_use_repo_root_constant: scope.py changed_paths and changed_python_paths hard-code REPO_ROOT; tests cannot inject a temporary repository. The detached-evidence runner also needs to call the same production functions against the real repo.
known_defects_in_cor11.range_tests_use_hardcoded_repo_commits: tests/verifiers/test_verifier_core_migration_audit01.py uses FIXTURE_BASE/FIXTURE_SUBJECT commit IDs that mirror the k9b repo and break history-coupled isolation. The tests must use a hermetic temporary Git repository.
known_defects_in_cor11.detached_evidence_has_independent_path_r: The /tmp/closure_evidence_XX/* manifests are produced by independent shell commands (git diff / git rev-parse / echo) that bypass the production code paths. The detached evidence must call the same production functions.

cli_writer_unification.goal: scripts/verifiers_audit/cli's cmd_write must write the audit set ONLY through write_audit(layout=canonical_layout())
cli_writer_unification.forbidden_imports_in_cli: Forbidden in cli.py: _write_atomic, _json_dumps, _dump_helpers_shard, render_markdown. The CLI may import only the high-level writer and canonical layout.
cli_writer_unification.cmd_write_signature: def cmd_write(gate_classification: dict[str, object] | None = None) -> int. When gate_classification is not None, command prints ERROR and returns 2 BEFORE any write is performed (zero side effects).
cli_writer_unification.writer_success_path: write_audit(layout=canonical_layout()) is the sole production writer call. (OSError, ValueError, AuditWriteError) is caught and returns 1; success is 0.
tests_required: caller-supplied gate_classification returns 2 before writer invocation
no artifact changes after rejected or failed writes
cli.py source contains no direct report-file writing calls
removed_from_cli: hash calculation for the in-memory index

fail_closed_range_api.new_typed_error: class RangeResolutionError(RuntimeError): __init__(self, *, base: str, subject: str, returncode: int, stderr: str) -> None
fail_closed_range_api._run_git_diff_names_contract: argv list (no shell quoting), capture_output=True, check=False, no text=True, no splitlines(), no strip() on pathnames. On non-zero returncode: raise RangeResolutionError(base, subject, returncode, stderr). On zero: return tuple of os.fsdecode(raw) for raw in proc.stdout.split(b'\0') if raw.
fail_closed_range_api.nul_delimited_parser: git diff -z --diff-filter=ACMRT produces NUL-separated paths. The parser splits on NUL bytes and rejects empty entries. Whitespace (leading, trailing, interior) is preserved verbatim.
forbidden_patterns: Returning an empty manifest after Git failure
Suppressing stderr or substituting HEAD/index/working tree
fail_closed_range_api.valid_empty_range: A valid equal-commit range MAY return an empty tuple. An invalid range MUST raise RangeResolutionError.

repository_injectable_range.changed_paths: def changed_paths(base: str, subject: str, *, repo_root: Path = REPO_ROOT) -> tuple[str, ...]
repository_injectable_range.changed_python_paths: def changed_python_paths(base: str, subject: str, *, repo_root: Path = REPO_ROOT) -> tuple[str, ...]
repository_injectable_range.detached_evidence_uses_same_functions: The detached-evidence runner calls changed_paths() and changed_python_paths() with the live REPO_ROOT default; the test suite calls the same functions with a tmp_path repo_root.
repository_injectable_range.no_hardcoded_commit_fixtures: Tests must NOT contain permanent k9b commit IDs (F10, S10, F11, S11). FIXTURE_BASE / FIXTURE_SUBJECT and the F11/S10 ancestry comment are deleted.

commits_made: path with trailing whitespace (skipped if not supported by Git/filesystem)
hermetic_range_fixture.argv_lists_only: Do not shell-quote or manually concatenate commands. Pass argv lists.

detached_evidence_binding.new_production_command: scripts/verifiers_audit/collect_r2_evidence.py (or a new dedicated evidence module) exposes a command that accepts --base, --subject, --repo-root, --output-dir; calls changed_paths() and changed_python_paths(); calls build_ruff_argv(); writes the three manifests; executes the returned Ruff argv; records stdout, stderr, exit_code, hashes; exits nonzero on any range/ruff failure.
detached_evidence_binding.no_shell_regeneration: The detached evidence MUST NOT regenerate paths using independent shell commands. The changed-paths.txt, changed-python-paths.txt, and ruff-input-paths.txt are produced by the same production code path used by tests.
detached_evidence_binding.required_equality: production changed_python_paths output == detached changed-python-paths.txt == detached ruff-input-paths.txt == paths in executed Ruff argv

module_autouse_mutation_guard.preserved: The CORRECTION11 canonical_artifacts_remain_unchanged fixture (module-scope, autouse=True) is preserved unchanged. The CORRECTION12 modifications do not touch any canonical artifact.
